Poland, Silesia, near Katowice

Notes: It was an aftershock of the 5.8 quake on June 17. Additional damage to buildings was caused, and thirteen people suffered injuries.

United States, California, 11 km southwest of Searles Valley
Notes: The largest foreshock of the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes was felt in Las Vegas and Los Angeles. Structural damage and some fires occurred in Ridgecrest, near the epicenter. Country and location: Poland, Lower Silesia, 6 km west northwest of Rudna
Notes: Damage was observed in Rudna copper mine. One miner died, trapped in the rubble, and five others were injured.

Country and location: United States, California, 18 km east of Ridgecrest
Notes: The mainshock of the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes was again felt in Las Vegas and Los Angeles, and as far away as Ensenada, Mexico. Further structural damage and additional fires occurred in Ridgecrest, near the epicenter. Five people were injured.

Iran, Khuzestan, 31 km southeast of Masjed Soleyman
Notes: The earthquake caused damage in Khuzestan region, like cracks in walls and fallen roofs. One person died of a heart attack, and around 100 people were slightly injured.

Notes: The July 2019 Cotabato earthquake damaged structures, including a ceiling, and classes were suspended. Three students were injured after fleeing in panic, and one person also died of a heart attack.

Philippines, Caraga, 7 km east of Cantilan
Notes: The municipality of Madrid was hit with structures/buildings suffering damage, including a restaurant tipped over in Cantilan. 63 people were injured in the quake.

Australia, Western Australia offshore, 198 km west of Cable Beach
Notes: It tied the strongest earthquake ever recorded in Australia. Slight damage to buildings was observed in Broome.

Notes: During the 2019 North Maluku earthquake, severe damage occurred in Halmahera, like collapsed buildings and cracked roads. 14 people died (five of them later in the hospital after being badly injured) and 129 others were injured.

Indonesia, East Java offshore, 46 km south southeast of Muncar
Notes: Some infrastructure was damaged in Bali and East Java. Seven people were injured, five of them in Bali.

Notes: Power outages and some structural failures were observed in the 2019 Athens earthquake. Three people were slightly injured by the rubble.

India, Maharashtra offshore, 25 km southwest of Shirgaon
Notes: One man was killed when his thatched house fell on him, and his wife injured.

Notes: During the 2019 Batanes earthquake, many old buildings were damaged in Itbayat, mostly in rural areas. Nine people died and around 60 others were injured.
